card.name: No specific antidote in overdose sections
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "no" in "There is no specific antidote/treatment" within overdosage sections. Also fires weakly on a few words partway through terms like overhydration and anticoagulation.

modes.label: No specific antidote
modes.description: The word "no" right after "There is" in overdose management text, before "specific antidote" or "specific treatment".
modes.example: Management of Overdosage There is<< no>> specific antidote to risperidone

modes.label: Partway through medical terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a long medical term such as overhydration or anticoagulation.
modes.example: When warfarin is co-administered with nevirapine, antico<<ag>>ulation levels should be monitored frequently.

modes.label: Right depth
modes.description: The word "right" in planting advice, before "depth".
modes.example: Plant bulbs at the<< right>> depth.
